caption.zh: 马奈《吹笛少年》，1866年，奥赛博物馆

note.zh: 两幅画里，人物都站在一片几乎空白的背景前。这里两幅都是原作。
note.en: In both paintings, the figure stands against an almost empty background. Both images are originals.

title.en: A boy from the Imperial Guard

text.zh: 画中是拿破仑三世帝国卫队乐队里的一个少年乐手，他的名字没有留下来。
text.en: He is a young musician from the band of Napoleon III's Imperial Guard. His name has not come down to us.

text.zh: 他穿着缀着金扣子的黑上衣、红裤子，戴着一顶装饰过的帽子。
text.en: He wears a black jacket with gold buttons, red trousers and a decorated cap.

text.zh: 背景是一片平坦的灰色，地面和墙几乎分不清。
text.en: The background is a flat, plain grey; floor and wall can barely be told apart.

text.zh: 衣服的褶皱，只用几道白色线条就勾了出来。
text.en: The folds of his clothes are marked by just a few streaks of white.

text.zh: 1865年，马奈在马德里的普拉多博物馆看到委拉斯开兹的画，深受启发。
text.en: In 1865, at the Prado in Madrid, Manet saw the paintings of Velázquez and was deeply inspired.

text.zh: 一个普通的少年乐手，被马奈画得像一位西班牙贵族。
text.en: An ordinary young musician, painted by Manet like a Spanish grandee.

text.zh: 1865年，马奈去西班牙旅行，在普拉多博物馆看到了委拉斯开兹的画。他说，在委拉斯开兹的一幅画里，背景消失了，围绕着人物的是空气。
text.en: In 1865, Manet travelled to Spain and saw the paintings of Velázquez at the Prado. In one of them, he said, the background disappears: it is air that surrounds the figure.

alt.zh: 马奈《吹笛少年》1866，巴黎奥赛博物馆
alt.en: Édouard Manet, The Fifer, 1866, Musée d'Orsay, Paris

text.zh: 回到巴黎后，他画了这个少年乐手。1866年，官方沙龙拒绝了这幅画。
text.en: Back in Paris, he painted this young musician. In 1866, the official Salon rejected it.

alt.zh: 马奈《吹笛少年》1866，巴黎奥赛博物馆
alt.en: Édouard Manet, The Fifer, 1866, Musée d'Orsay, Paris

text.zh: 作家左拉却在这幅画里看到了一种真正现代的感觉，开始公开为马奈辩护。1911年，它进入了法国国家收藏。
text.en: The writer Émile Zola, however, saw a truly modern feeling in it, and began to defend Manet in public. In 1911 the painting entered the French national collection.

final.en: The background disappears: it is air that surrounds him.

text.zh: 1865年，马奈去西班牙旅行，在普拉多博物馆看到了委拉斯开兹的画。他说，在委拉斯开兹的一幅画里，背景消失了，围绕着人物的是空气。
text.en: In 1865, Manet travelled to Spain and saw the paintings of Velázquez at the Prado. In one of them, he said, the background disappears: it is air that surrounds the figure.

text.zh: 回到巴黎后，他画了这个少年乐手。1866年，官方沙龙拒绝了这幅画。
text.en: Back in Paris, he painted this young musician. In 1866, the official Salon rejected it.

text.zh: 作家左拉却在这幅画里看到了一种真正现代的感觉，开始公开为马奈辩护。1911年，它进入了法国国家收藏。
text.en: The writer Émile Zola, however, saw a truly modern feeling in it, and began to defend Manet in public. In 1911 the painting entered the French national collection.
